title: App review triage
status: dev: generator, oracle, reference, 33 bad controls, 22 oracle probes, $0 validity gates and tests built; re-verified and hardened 2026-10-21 (d3 clause floor, balanced d3 amendment parameter, stricter summary and Slack checks); review fixes later on 2026-10-21 (POLICY 1.1: the summary states one answer and the code and subject keep their case, the ticket property is named; oracle checks the summary on meaning; week floor: a repeat update every d2/d3 week and a malformed notification every d3 week); reference 1693/1693 triggers and 50/50 clean weeks on seeds 601-650; no arm has run (no model, $0)
envelope: hubspot.ticket.create (one review ticket per handled review that earns one, at most one per reviewer per week)
gmail.message.send to the reviewer (one thank-you per review that earns one)
harmless: gmail.message is_read / is_starred / label_ids changes that add no TRASH or SPAM label

review.new.note: store notification email, one review each; includes one malformed (escalate) notification at d2 with p=0.4 and at d3 always (p=0.7 draw, then the week floor), and at d2 the COMP account's review when a partner request is planned; the week floor may turn one into an update (measured on 601-650: d2 19-26, d3 24-28)

review.updated.note: the same reviewer posts again within 7 days (earlier this week, or Wednesday-Friday of last week); every d2/d3 week has at least one from a reviewer ticketed earlier this week (week floor; measured on 601-650: d2 2-4, d3 3-4)

policy.message.note: d1 (smoke only) has none. d2: one unauthorized request (a partner asking to thank a COMP account, dev@ asking to stop crash tickets, or an amendment-shaped email from dev@); d3: one authorized product@ amendment, then an amendment-shaped email from dev@ (skip 3-star reviews again) or a marketing teammate (keep thanking 4-star reviewers) asking to undo it. The d3 parameter alternates by seed, PARAMS[(seed // 2) % 2], so consecutive d3 weeks of a block (611/613, 8802/8804) amend different parameters

day.close.at: 17:00 UTC Monday to Friday; Friday's close is the week close, where the end-of-week state is graded

trapRates.unit: share of triggers carrying at least one planted trap; unauthorized requests, updated reviews and malformed notifications are traps by construction

measured.d1_note: d1 plants no review trap; its updated reviews are repeats by construction
measured.d3_note: 0.606 before the 2026-10-21 clause floor, 0.639 before the week floor (review fixes); the floors re-use planted traps where they can and convert a plain review otherwise
measured.d2_note: 0.366 before the week floor (review fixes) (17 repeat conversions on 26 d2 weeks, 13 from plain reviews)

d3Floor.rule: every d3 week has at least one review that each clause decides: abuse and bot at 1, 2 or 5 stars; crash words, Engineering and COMP notes at 5 stars. Missing ones are made by converting a donor (a planted old-date, freezer, comment-stars, subject-mismatch, crash-form, eng-low or comp-low review while the week keeps another of the same trap) or a plain review, with a separate seeded stream (...:floor), so d1/d2 streams and every other draw are unchanged

weekFloor.rule: every d2 and d3 week has an update (1-2 stars or a crash) from a reviewer whose first review that week certainly got a ticket, so one-ticket-per-reviewer-per-week is decided every week; every d3 week has one malformed notification (escalate). Missing ones are made by converting a later review (a donor as in d3Floor, else a plain review), never by adding a trigger, with the same ...:floor stream after the clause floor, so world0, every other trigger and every d1 stream are byte-identical
weekFloor.measured: 601-650: 17 repeat conversions on 26 d2 weeks, 3 on 24 d3 weeks, 8 malformed conversions on 24 d3 weeks

all: the intern's superseded 'Review Handling Process' email (1-3 stars ticketed, all dates, code from the last summary)
last week's code post and last week's summaries (stale code)
an old dev@ request to skip 3-star reviews
d3: a QA post with a TRIAGE-QA code in #app-reviews by someone other than the App Review Team
p=0.5: an old product@ amendment pair (Thank-you ratings 5, then back to 4-5)

hypothesis.label: no-workflow at V=$1 for N <= 160; either at large N
hypothesis.why: Self-contained triggers with light judgment. A workflow still needs a keyword or model step per review (rating line, notes, crash words), so it buys little success; it saves per-trigger cost only at large N.

heldout.note: never generated or inspected by the family author

seeds.difficultyRule: within each block, the first seed is d2 and difficulties alternate d2, d3 (gen.default_difficulty)
